name: fight15-s26
title: Edit setup and Advanced are two doors; ending the session asks first

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonLobbyEditSetup
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
video_mark edit-setup-host
assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle E D I T   S E T U P
assert_visible TabHostPageSeats 1
assert_visible TabHostPageRules 1
assert_visible TabHostPageConnection 0
assert_visible TabHostPageTiming 0
assert_visible TabHostPageRecovery 0
assert_visible TabHostPageFiles 0
assert_visible TabHostPageSession 0
assert_visible ButtonHostOptDefaults 0
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
activate ButtonLobbyOptions
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
video_mark advanced-host
assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle A D V A N C E D
assert_visible TabHostPageConnection 1
assert_visible TabHostPageSession 1
activate TabHostPageSession
wait_ms 600
activate ButtonHostSessEnd
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
assert_label ButtonHostSessEnd Confirm end
assert_label LabelHostSessEndHint Press Confirm end to close the game for every player
assert_text_fits LabelHostSessEndHint
video_mark end-confirm-host
activate TabHostPageRules
wait_ms 400
activate TabHostPageSession
wait_ms 600
assert_label ButtonHostSessEnd End session
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/scene-end.json 120
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonLobbyEditSetup
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
video_mark match-details-joiner
assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle M A T C H   D E T A I L S
assert_visible TabHostPageTiming 1
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/scene-end.json 300
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit

checklist.what: Edit setup shows the game's setup alone, under its own title.
events: ^assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle "E D I T   S E T U P".*PASS

checklist.what: Advanced shows every page under its own title.
events: ^assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle "A D V A N C E D".*PASS

checklist.what: End session asks for a second press and names its consequence; another page disarms it.
A joined player still reads every page of the match's details.
events: ^assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle "M A T C H   D E T A I L S".*PASS
